title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1101 | 太空猫星云、百万鳗鱼群、四千年爪印
description:
🎧 本期音频为全英文，适合有一定英语基础的小朋友。

👧 今天 Mia 和 Lina 聊了三个新鲜事：

🐱 两台太空望远镜联手拍到一只长着发光眼睛的“猫”——其实是七千五百光年外的猫头星云！
🐟 澳大利亚塔斯马尼亚附近的海底火山旁，聚集了二百八十万条鳗鱼，科学家还不知道它们为什么偏偏选中这座山！
🐾 土耳其出土的一块砖上，留着四千年前的狗狗爪印，是一只小狗走过还没干的泥砖留下的！

📖 Word of the day: nebula（星云）

🎮 小挑战：今晚画一只云和星星组成的太空猫，再把今天的单词 nebula 教给一个人！

---
🇬🇧 In today's episode:

🐱 Two telescopes photographed a space cloud shaped like a cat, with one glowing eye!
🐟 Two million eight hundred thousand eels gathered around one underwater volcano near Tasmania, and scientists still do not know why they picked that mountain!
🐾 A brick found in Turkey carries dog paw prints four thousand years old, left when a dog walked across the wet mud!

📖 Word of the day: nebula

🎮 Tiny challenge: draw the space cat tonight and teach someone the word nebula!

📝 生词本 Words to learn

1. nebula（星云）
a big cloud of gas and dust in space, where new stars are born
例：the Cat's Head Nebula（猫头星云）

2. eel（鳗鱼）
a long, slippery fish that looks like a snake
例：two million eels（两百万条鳗鱼）

3. volcano（火山）
a mountain that can shoot out hot rock and ash
例：an underwater volcano（海底火山）

4. paw print（爪印）
the mark an animal's foot leaves behind
例：a dog paw print（狗狗的爪印）
